Each tile counts one partner's social_channels or social_posts rows, and no partner is selected. ◉ No partner is selected, so nothing on this page is loaded. The partner picker in the header has no list to read. It used to offer three partners that were made up, and every read and write on this screen was sent with one of their ids — against a partner that does not exist. Those are gone, and nothing is sent until a real partner can be picked. Connecting a channel, queueing a post and publishing all work once a partner can be picked. The channel and post lists below stay empty until the read that fills them is built. SS-01 / CONNECTED CHANNELS — SOCIAL_CHANNELS Each connected social account appears here once a partner is selected. No partner can be selected yet: this screen has no partner list to read, so nothing is loaded and nothing is sent. SS-02 / NOT CONNECTED — The permitted channels a partner has not connected appears here once a partner is selected. No partner can be selected yet: this screen has no partner list to read, so nothing is loaded and nothing is sent. Connect a channel via OAuth. Tokens store encrypted on social_channels. Connect Facebook Connect Instagram Connect LinkedIn LINKEDIN ORGANIZATION ID — LINKEDIN ONLY LinkedIn will not connect without it. Facebook and Instagram do not use it. Connecting a channel needs a partner. No partner is selected. SS-03 / COMPOSE A POST 5 FIELDS · SCHEDULE() CHANNEL — CHANNEL_ID — no channels — one post targets exactly one channel; there is no cross-post OFFER TYPE — REQUIRED — not set — funding credit_cards credit_repair NOT NULL; screen() blocks with offer_type_missing when absent CAPTION the only text field on social_posts — no title, hashtags, link_url or alt_text columns exist 0 chars ASSET — OPTIONAL, ONE ONLY — none — asset_id is a single nullable FK — no carousels, no join table schedule() never reads creative_assets.compliance_state, and no CHECK or trigger in 049 gates on it — a pending or blocked asset attaches and publishes SCHEDULED_FOR — OVERRIDE (UTC) no channel selected RUN GUARDRAIL PREVIEW QUEUE POST PUBLISH DUE NOW CLEAR No partner selected — nothing can be queued, published or connected from this screen yet. SS-04 / GUARDRAIL VERDICT — 0 REASONS Type a caption and pick an offer type. Nothing is screened until both exist — an empty offer_type is itself a block. Organic screens with platform = null (scheduler.mjs:56–59). That means the TikTok credit-repair structural block and the Meta special-ad-category force are skipped by construction, and no targeting is screened. The CROA, claims and disclosure copy rules apply in full — a caption is judged exactly as an ad would be. This panel compiles the same seeded compliance_rules patterns the engine uses, so it is a faithful preview — but the authoritative verdict is the one screen() returns in src/compliance/screen.mjs. screen.mjs does not write it here. schedule() issues its own INSERT into compliance_screenings (scheduler.mjs:64–70); the organic path never calls screenAndRecord(), and that INSERT names neither platform nor rules_version, so both columns stay NULL on every organic screening row. The engine fails closed: any error at all returns blocked / screen_error. Rules are also cached per org for 60s, so a rule edit can take a minute to bite. SS-05 / SCHEDULED QUEUE SOCIAL_POSTS Queue — Review queue — Failed — Published — Audit trail — CHANNEL all OFFER_TYPE all funding credit_cards credit_repair NO PARTNER SELECTED DRAFT set by the INSERT and moved on inside the same call — never a resting state QUEUED screened and waiting for publishDue POSTING set and cleared in one transaction; a row stuck here means a crash, not work in progress POSTED external_post_id returned FAILED 3 attempts burned; opens a task BLOCKED the guardrail refused it; terminal Posts waiting to publish appears here once a partner is selected. No partner can be selected yet: this screen has no partner list to read, so nothing is loaded and nothing is sent. publishDue reads status = 'queued' AND scheduled_for <= now(), ordered by scheduled_for, LIMIT 50 per invocation. A row whose channel is not active is skipped with { skipped: 'channel_not_active' } — the post stays queued and attempt is not incremented. A row with scheduled_for IS NULL is never due and will sit here forever. SS-10 / POSTING WINDOW CHANNEL — none — The posting slots a channel will use appears here once a partner is selected. No partner can be selected yet: this screen has no partner list to read, so nothing is loaded and nothing is sent. Slots are evaluated in UTC. nextBestTime uses getUTCDay() and Date.UTC() and never reads social_channels.timezone, even though the column comment in 049:34–36 describes best_times as being in the partner's timezone. The stored timezone is shown above as data; rendering these slots in it would show a time the scheduler will not use. The scan runs 8 days forward and returns the first slot strictly after now; an empty best_times returns null rather than inventing a time. SS-11 / APPROVAL SETTING PARTNER_MODULE_SETTINGS The approve_before_launch setting appears here once a partner is selected.
